posts.author: Xbalanque
posts.body: Hello, I'm using Yanfly's Status Menu Core and I would like to hide Max MP, M.Attack and M.Defense from one of my actors as he does not use those parameters. I tried googling my problem but everything I found was about completly hiding or deleting parameters. I just want to hide them for 1 actor not for all actors. Could anybody help?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: It would help if you posted a solution you tried that hid all of the parameters for everyone - then someone can give you a simple modification to make it only apply to one actor.
